meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, House Price Index (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: The latest quarter is provisional and is finalised with the next release; RBI rebased the index in 2010-11 and 2022-23 (three bases, never joined).
meta.coverage: House prices in 18 cities, % change on a year ago, base 2022-23 = 100
meta.note: Derived: (index / index four quarters earlier - 1) x 100, computed from RBI DBIE report 688 (HPI-Q1:2022-23) within this base only.
